question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Indulge**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indulge **means to allow oneself to enjoy something, especially a pleasure or luxury. (स्वयं को किसी चीज़ का आनंद लेने की अनुमति देना, विशेष रूप से किसी आनंद या विलासिता का)

 
 
• **Example: ***After a long week of work, she decided to indulge in a relaxing spa day to pamper herself*.
 
 
 
• "**indulge**" is the appropriate word for the blank as it conveys the idea that young people from affluent families willingly and excessively partake in reckless driving, even when they are not eligible for a driving license.

Therefore, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Frustrate: **Feeling disappointed or discouraged when efforts do not yield the desired results. (जब प्रयासों से वांछित परिणाम नहीं मिलते तो निराश या हतोत्साहित महसूस करना)
 
• **Attack: **To engage in aggressive action or violence against someone or something. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु के विरुद्ध आक्रामक कार्रवाई या हिंसा में संलग्न होना)
 
• **Praise: **Expressing approval, admiration, or positive recognition for someone's achievements or qualities. (किसी की उपलब्धियों या गुणों के लिए अनुमोदन, प्रशंसा या सकारात्मक मान्यता व्यक्त करना)
